rules.message: Keep method="post" alongside data-hx-post so a no-JS submit still works.
data-hx-target (the error container) must point at an element in the document. (warn: fragments may target elements elsewhere on the page)
Swap the field-errors fragment with innerHTML into the error container. (innerHTML is also the htmx default — omitting the attribute is fine; anything else is not)
Disable the submit button during the request (data-hx-disabled-elt).
